brief: Reconcile a statement with a receipt log and identify the unmatched transaction.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Find the unmatched movement"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Encuentra el movimiento sin conciliar"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Encontre o movimento sem conciliar"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Reconcile a statement with a receipt log and identify the unmatched transaction.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: Match statement entries with receipts before explaining any difference.
instruction.misconception: Assuming a difference is fraud or treating equal totals as proof that every individual transaction matches.
instruction.numeracy_support: The worked examples introduce the required operation; every assessed task retains its own amounts and assumptions.

evidence.reasoning: Match dates, amounts and references across records. Investigate unmatched entries; a difference alone does not explain its cause.
The extra entry lacks a matching record in this scene.
Matching identifying details link the records without duplicating the payment.
Equal totals can hide mismatched individual entries.
Pending status may explain why a completed entry is absent.
Reconciliation includes verified returns as well as outgoing purchases.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.
